name: Uninvited Feelings
source:
Martin Seaver is invited to his friend's wedding months after his own serious relationship ended badly. Complicated emotions pervade his head as he tries to distract himself at the party and they only worsen when he notices a certain person he's been avoiding is attending the ceremony.

[From [url=https://cardigan-cardigan.itch.io/uninvited-feelings]itch.io[/url]]
